compose:

services:
  victim_web:
    container_name: cr-demo-scn_850a566c7a91-victim_web
    networks:
    - scenario-internal
    - external
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m

    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'

      context: ../../templates/demo-app
      dockerfile: Dockerfile

      - CMD
      - python
      - -c
      - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:80/health',
        timeout=2).read()
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 2s
    ports:
    - target: 80
      published: '42000'
      host_ip: 127.0.0.1
      protocol: tcp
    expose:
    - '80'

    read_only: true

    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m

    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: cr-demo-scn_850a566c7a91-db:local

      context: ../../templates/demo-app

      test:
      - CMD

        timeout=2).read()
      interval: 5s

      retries: 5

    - target: 5432
      published: '42001'
      host_ip: 127.0.0.1
      protocol: tcp
    expose:
    - '5432'

    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m

    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
